records.title: XunZi, an AI biologist, reveals disease-modifying targets

scope.decision_rationale: Introduces XunZi as an AI biologist that integrates logical reasoning and multimodal data fusion to generate de novo therapeutic target hypotheses. The abstract centers on biomedical data, publications, and hypothesis generation rather than a review or benchmark.
scope.evidence_snippet: "integrates logical reasoning and multimodal data fusion to autonomously generate de novo therapeutic target hypotheses"; trained on "24.4 million publications and 613.6 TB of multisource data".

architecture.decision_rationale: The abstract says XunZi can “autonomously generate de novo therapeutic target hypotheses,” but it does not specify a clearly generative architecture. It does show foundation-model-like scale and breadth, including training on 24.4 million publications and 613.6 TB of multisource data across many genes and diseases.
architecture.evidence_snippet: “autonomously generate de novo therapeutic target hypotheses”; “trained on 24.4 million publications and 613.6 TB of multisource data”
